dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Spera district, Khost province as of 24 June 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20220622AFG** This map illustrates potentially damaged buildings and damaged buildings in Spera district, Khost province of Afghanistan as detected by a NewSat image acquired on 24 June 2022. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 81 potentially damaged buildings, 12 damaged buildings and 170 shelters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
